about.title: About
about.courseDescription: We built this app as a team project for the RS School React course. RS School is a free course from The Rolling Scopes community where students learn frontend by working on real tasks with mentors.
about.projectDescription: The app is an editor for OpenAPI specs with a built-in REST client. You write a spec in JSON or YAML, the app checks it and shows the list of endpoints. Any endpoint can be tested right away: requests go through our server, so CORS doesn't get in the way. If you are signed in, the app also keeps your request history with some stats.
